taskA_judge_router.reading: Hop-1 post-expansion statistics, frontier-overlap, and expansion-size dynamics add no judge-routing signal beyond hop-0 statistics (mid-only AUROC 0.529 vs hop-0-only 0.553; with question embeddings both 0.60-0.62 - the small signal lives in the question embedding, not the retrieval features). The mid-retrieval router tracks but does not exceed the rate-matched mixture (delta +0.0003, CI [-0.007,+0.008], p~0.98).

taskB_joint_router.reading: Joint (K,B,judge) headroom on the pool is real and large: oracle 0.542@611 vs always-best K2B8 0.463@1110 (+0.079 F1 at -45% cost). But the trained RF joint router (mid-retrieval features + question embedding) collapses to the cheapest arm for 99.3% of queries and lands at 0.278 - far BELOW the always-best global config (delta -0.185, CI [-0.233,-0.138]). Headroom exists; learned routing over mid-retrieval features captures none of it.

use_in: 31Rd-Q1 (joint router realized), 31Rd-Q4 (mid-retrieval router), xxtL-W4, f7vF-W2 (ceiling strengthened on the joint axis)
